title: DataNepal source dataset
description: One upstream dataset as published by its original publisher. Provenance and licence live here, not on published tables: a single source can feed several tables, and licence compatibility is computed from the sources a table draws on.

publisher.description: The body that published it, not the aggregator we fetched it from.

artifact_url.description: The exact file fetched, when stable.

licence_id.description: Must exist in transform/seeds/licences.csv. Use 'unknown' rather than guessing.

licence_statement_url.description: Where the publisher states the terms. Absent means we inferred them.

vintage.description: Reference period of the data, distinct from when we fetched it.

revises_published_values.description: Whether the publisher restates previously published figures. Drives whether revision history matters for this source.

publisher_org_id.description: Who produced the data. Must exist in transform/seeds/organisations.csv.

acquired_from_org_id.description: Where DataNepal obtained this copy. Often the same as the publisher; different when a mirror or aggregator was used.

acquisition_method.description: How the copy was obtained. Drives ingestion fragility and the review bar.

acquisition_url.description: The exact URL the copy came from, which may differ from the landing page.

source_tier.description: Provenance authority of the publisher, not technical quality.

time_coverage.description: Span the dataset covers, e.g. '1960-2025'. Distinct from vintage.

commercial_reuse.description: Assessed, not assumed. 'unclear' blocks commercial redistribution pending review.

raw_artifact_sha256.description: Checksum of the immutable raw artifact, where one is retained.
